description: Financial account balance stored as float64. Contains 30 distinct non-null values across 30 records (100% unique) with no missing entries. Value range spans -150.5 to 99999.0. Contains suspected sentinel-coded values: 99999.0 (statistical outlier, 1 record) far exceeds the expected statistical range of 1525, and -150.5 (negative value, 1 record) deviates from the otherwise positive value distribution.
recommended_actions: [CLARIFY] Confirm business meaning of anomalous values: 99999.0 (suspected sentinel for missing/invalid data) and -150.5 (negative balance or sentinel). Determine appropriate handling (e.g., convert to NULL, preserve as overdraft, or exclude from aggregations).
